verdicts.reason: In HolSyntaxLib.lean, `RESULT (Clash t)` reduces to `@ARB α ⟨t⟩`, which is independent of `t` by proof irrelevance of `Nonempty α`; thus Lean proves `RESULT (Clash x) = RESULT (Clash y)` (e.g. for `true`/`false` or `True`/`False`) by `rfl`. In HOL4, `Definition RESULT_def` goes through `Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition` (`new_specification`) and saves only `∀t. RESULT (Result t) = t`, leaving `RESULT (Clash t)` unconstrained and consistent with returning `t`.
